items.title: Porch form
items.response: Porch has masonry pier shells, rendered returns/front beam, soffit, concealed roof and closed pier tops. P1 cores retained. Final height and absolute setout still require drawing/datum coordination.

items.title: Garage parapet and door
items.response: Garage has brick parapets, capping and a six-panel door. Roof and parapets are trimmed outside the upper-house envelope; Bedroom 4 is clear in the final image and intrusion check. Final height remains provisional. A tonal boundary remains on the roof and needs a shadow/finish review.

items.title: Black upstairs strips
items.response: Both black strips cleared in the final original-camera views (37 and49). Pixel probes confirm the previous black areas now receive light. Existing plaster was retained; connected planar lightmap charts replaced the fragmented charts.

items.title: Glazing and mirrors
items.response: Privacy glazing is now pale. Neutral mirror tint, box projection and 20% stronger static reflections improve the surfaces, but mirrors remain approximate cubemaps and some views show little reflection detail. No live reflection cameras or runtime blur.

items.title: Lighting and shadow
items.response: Neutral ceilings, upward baked fill, reduced yellow tint and softer sun shadows are in place. All four visibility-state bakes passed. Ground shadows still have some broad unevenness; headset appearance and sustained performance require wearer review.

items.title: Brick size
items.response: Existing world-space shader module is240x86mm including10mm joints, i.e.230x76mm bricks. Retain correct dimensions; no arbitrary1.7x rescaling.

items.title: Facade seams
items.status: Façade seams improved in final captures
items.response: Coplanar facade pieces now share connected planar lightmap charts. The vertical seams in view07 cleared. The deliberately separate alfresco fascia remains lighter than the upper render; remaining roof tone boundary is tracked underPHOTO-02.

items.title: Robe towers
items.response: Both607mm-wide towers retain their2016mm height and now have flush top caps. Exported normals are flat. A connected planar lighting chart across each side panel removed the visible diagonal and horizontal shading breaks in view47.

items.title: Stair rail ends
items.response: Added wall returns.1000mm rail and1200mm dwarf wall retained. Second strip corresponds to capping, not a redundant handrail.

items.title: Viewing directions
items.response: Room headings now face windows/fitout at slight angles. Theatre stop moved back to show the room; exterior photograph is an eye-height three-quarter view. All22 arrivals and menu-clearance tests passed. Views49/50 retain older cameras for comparison.

items.title: Powder door-head stub
items.response: Full-resolution photo shows the corridor bulkhead beyond the powder doorway. Matches the explicit corridor bulkhead geometry from sheet07; not deleted.

runtime_cost_note: Lighting changes are baked. Glass uses a material emission term; mirrors use static 128 px cubemaps. No runtime blur or reflection camera was added. Headset performance remains unmeasured for this build.
